title: The 8 Best Drawknife 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for drawknife 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at drawknife 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Flexcut KN25 3-Inch Draw Knife
products.blurb: Key specs: High-carbon steel, Ash handles, 8-inch blade.
strengths: The most commonly recommended production drawknife for green woodworking and chair making
High-carbon steel takes and holds a sharp edge for extended shaping sessions
Ash handles are comfortable and durable -- the traditional handle material for drawknives
8-inch blade is the most versatile size for chair legs, bow staves, and general shaping
limitations: Requires initial sharpening from the factory edge
High-carbon steel rusts -- requires oil after each use in humid shops
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Robert Larson Arno Flat Forged Drawknife
products.blurb: Key specs: Hot-forged 6-inch blade, Ball-turned wooden handles, Leather protective sheath.
strengths: Hot forging produces a denser, better-wearing edge than stamped modern alternatives
Ball-turned handles are comfortable and distribute grip pressure evenly across long sessions
Leather sheath protects the edge and makes safe storage simple
A frequent recommendation among professional chairmakers for a primary forged drawknife
limitations: Shorter 6-inch blade is better suited to detail work than wide stock removal

products.name: Two Cherries 500-1320 225mm Straight Drawknife
products.blurb: Key specs: 10-inch blade, German steel, Hardwood handles.
strengths: Two Cherries is the most respected current-production tool maker for drawknives
10-inch blade for wider, faster cuts than the 8-inch -- correct for large green wood stock
German steel holds an edge comparable to vintage American tools
The correct new-production drawknife for woodworkers who cannot source vintage tools
limitations: 10-inch blade is larger than needed for most chair leg work

products.name: Morakniv Wood Carving Hook Knife 164
products.blurb: Key specs: Sandvik stainless steel, 0.5-inch internal radius hook, One-handed carving knife.
strengths: Morakniv is the Swedish maker known for razor-sharp steel at reasonable prices
Arrives very sharp from the factory -- ready to use without initial sharpening
The hooked blade complements a drawknife for hollowing spoons, bowls, and small concave surfaces
The most affordable quality carving tool for woodworkers starting with green wood
limitations: One-handed knife, not a two-handed drawknife -- a companion tool rather than a drawknife substitute
Smaller scope of work than a full-size drawknife

products.name: Koch Industries 10-Inch Drawknife
products.blurb: Key specs: 10-inch blade, Straight blade geometry, Cushioned grip handles.
strengths: The wide 10-inch blade removes material faster than shorter drawknives on large stock
Straight blade geometry suits flat-surface shaping and peg making
Cushioned handles reduce hand fatigue during long shaping sessions
A solid new-production drawknife for wide green wood stock at a reasonable price
limitations: Heavier than a compact chairmaking drawknife
Straight blade is less useful for curved work than a slightly curved blade

products.name: Two Cherries 500-2210 Inshave
products.blurb: Key specs: Curved blade, Bowl hollowing, Chair seat.
strengths: Curved inshave blade for hollowing chair seats and bowl blanks
The correct tool for the saddle seat cut on Windsor chairs -- cannot be done with a straight drawknife
Reaches into concave surfaces that a straight drawknife cannot access
Used with a shaving horse for the most control during deep hollowing
limitations: Specialized tool -- only useful for concave surface work
Requires more skill to sharpen than a straight drawknife

products.name: Shaving Horses, Lap Shaves and Other Woodland Vices
products.blurb: Key specs: Book of plans and techniques, Multiple shaving horse designs, Green woodworking focus.
strengths: Covers several shaving horse designs so a builder can pick the one that fits their bench and body size
Diagrams and cut lists make it practical to shop-build a shaving horse from dimensional lumber
A shaving horse is the correct workholding for all drawknife and spokeshave work -- hands-free clamping via a foot pedal
Written specifically for green woodworking, not general woodshop furniture building
limitations: A book, not a physical tool -- still requires lumber and build time to get a working shaving horse
Some designs assume access to a pole lathe or similar green woodworking setup

products.name: DMT Diafold Diamond Flat Folding File, Extra-Coarse
products.blurb: Key specs: Diamond file, In-use sharpening, Multiple grits.
strengths: Diamond files sharpen drawknives without removing them from the shaving horse -- sharpen in place
No water or oil required -- correct for green wood shop use where liquids create mess
Multiple grit options for coarse reshaping and fine honing
The correct field-sharpening method for drawknives during an active shaping session
limitations: Less effective for major edge repair than a bench stone

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
